title: Autoscale managed endpoints within spend limits
goal: Scale an admitted deployment using queue depth, latency, min/max replicas, and stabilization windows; load tests show bounded scale decisions and scale-down drains in-flight requests. Deps (vectors): VC-201-024, VC-201-052, VC-201-055. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_056_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
